title: Reconfigure reports success but changes nothing once Options saved the Entities page
claim: After one save of the Options flow's Entities page, a reconfigure that changes the indoor sensor and the weather entity aborts with reconfigure_successful while the effective configuration keeps both old values (2 of 2 changed keys shadowed; 0 on an entry with no options), and the reopened form is prefilled from entry.data rather than the running value.
mechanism: _async_save_reconfigure writes the first screen's answers into entry.data only; the coordinator runs on {**entry.data, **entry.options}; the Entities options page (_OPTION_FIELDS rows with step 'entities') stores the same keys (price source/entity, token, weather, indoor, outdoor, ...) in entry.options, which then win over every later reconfigure. The prefill reads self._reconfigure_entry.data, so it also shows a value that is not running. D10-criteria Q2: the reconfiguration-flow row's done fails at this site.

evidence.unit: first-screen keys whose reconfigured answer is not the effective config
evidence.machine: local macOS box B2 (orchestrator machine), Python 3.14 venv-ci
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other finder seats running; a count, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb: wrap _async_save_reconfigure in memory so it also removes the first-screen keys from entry.options before writing entry.data

metric_definition: shadowed = first-screen keys a reconfigure changed whose value in {**entry.data, **entry.options} after reconfigure_successful differs from the answer
phenomenon_property: A reconfigure that reports success leaves every first-screen key it was given in force in the effective configuration the coordinator is built from, and the reconfigure form is prefilled from that effective configuration.

null_control.note: the same reconfigure on an entry whose options were never saved takes effect in full

reproduction_steps: Set up an entry (entity price source) with indoor sensor A and weather.home.
Options -> Entities: change the indoor sensor to B and save.
Entry menu -> Reconfigure: the form shows indoor A; choose C and weather.other; it reports success.
The coordinator still reads indoor B and weather.home.
proposed_fix_scope: config_flow.py: the reconfigure write (and its prefill) operate on the effective configuration -- drop the written keys from entry.options in the same async_update_entry, and prefill from {**data, **options}
